title: 第33章 他要对付的是我

第33章 他要对付的是我-《我发现了世界BUG》

上一章

下一章

秦朗的话说完，林舒陷入了漫长的沉默。

这一刻，他不知道应该用什么样的态度去面对眼前这个人，甚至不知道应该用什么态度去面对这个世界。

快，太快了。

从自己接触到仪轨，到现在，世界的面纱被一层一层地揭开，实际上才过去了一周的时间而已。

可这一周之内，自己那些固化的、陈旧的认知，却已经被一点点击溃。

当秦朗说出“科学”的时候，自己还在犹豫。

自己还心存侥幸，想着他们可能只是想用更科学、更专业的方法来解释厉雨的死而已。

可当他提到“法脉”时，形势便开始以自己不可阻挡的趋势转变。

他们显然知道一切。

或许在他们的知识体系里，“仪轨”并不被称作“仪轨”，就像厉雨一样，他也认为那些东西是“法术”。

可毫无疑问的，秦朗正在跟自己聊的东西，跟自己真正认知到的东西，是同一种东西......

当然同样的，秦朗也完全了解自己所掌握的一切。

开什么玩笑......

你们是民调局的吗？

林舒眼神纠结地看向秦朗，后者摊了摊手说道：

“我知道你还在犹豫，也知道你有秘密。”

他耸了耸肩。

“我也有秘密，我们组里的每个人都有秘密，毕竟，我们的工作性质特殊，整体的组织架构也很初级。”

“现在，我们搭起来的东西本质上还只是个草台班子而已。”

“但是没关系，也就是因为这样，只要不影响大局，我们也没那么多心思去刺探个人的隐私。”

“抓主要矛盾----在问题严重的现状下，这是我们的宗旨。”

“而我们现在的主要矛盾是.......厉雨的死。”

“他的死跟我们正在调查的另一个重大案件产生了联系，现在，我们必须要判断，他的死到底是这个重大案件中的一部分，还是仅仅因为你这个中间人而恰好被联系起来的偶然事件。”

“这两种判断，将对我们后续的工作产生截然不同的、极其重大的影响。”

“那么.......我们开始吧。”

“你知不知道，厉雨到底是怎么死的？”

秦朗的问题提得很直接----本质上来说，他是在重复贺成之前已经问过的问题。

但现在，情况已经完全不同了。

秦朗抛出来的不是一个简单的问题，这实际上是一种......

投名状？

只要自己回答了他的问题，就等同于自承身份、默认入伙了。

这对自己来说到底是好事还是坏事？

林舒下意识地挠了挠头，脑子里分析着自己的状况。

没错，我是接触到了仪轨，而仪轨提供的力量，也确实能在很大程度上改变自己的生活。

但同时，我也面临着严重的生命威胁。

无论是来自甲方的加害，还是那不可捉摸的“天收”，都在催促着自己加快脚步。

而想要加快脚步......

最好的办法，似乎就是借助更强大的势力了吧？

这个世界上有什么势力能比官方势力更强大、资源更多吗？

After Qin Lang finished speaking, Lin Shu fell into a long silence.

At this moment, he didn't know what attitude he should use to face the person in front of him, or even what attitude he should use to face the world.

Fast, too fast.

In fact, only a week has passed since I came into contact with the ritual. Until now, the veil of the world has been lifted layer by layer.

But within this week, those solidified and old perceptions of mine have been shattered bit by bit.

When Qin Lang said "science", he was still hesitating.

I was still lucky, thinking that they might just want to use a more scientific and professional method to explain Li Yu's death.

But when he mentioned "Dharma Lineage", the situation began to change in its own unstoppable trend.

They obviously know everything.

Perhaps in their knowledge system, "rituals" are not called "rituals". Just like Li Yu, he also thinks those things are "spells".

But there is no doubt that what Qin Lang is talking to himself is the same thing as what he really knows...

Of course, Qin Lang also fully understands everything he has.

Are you kidding...

Are you from the polling bureau?

Lin Shu looked at Qin Lang with tangled eyes, who spread his hands and said:

"I know you are still hesitating, and I know you have a secret."

He shrugged.

"I also have secrets. Everyone in our group has secrets. After all, the nature of our work is special and the overall organizational structure is very rudimentary."

"Right now, what we have built is essentially just a grassroots team."

"But it doesn't matter. Because of this, as long as it doesn't affect the overall situation, we don't have that much thought to pry into personal privacy."

"Seizing the main contradiction--this is our purpose under the current situation of serious problems."

"And our main conflict now is... Li Yu's death."

"His death is connected to another major case we are investigating. Now, we have to judge whether his death is part of this major case, or whether it is just an accidental incident that happens to be connected because of you, the middleman."

"These two judgments will have completely different and extremely significant impacts on our subsequent work."

"Then... let's get started."

"Do you know how Li Yu died?"

Qin Lang's question was very direct - essentially, he was repeating the question He Cheng had asked before.

But now, the situation is completely different.

What Qin Lang asked was not a simple question, it was actually a...

Certificate of application?

As long as you answer his questions, it is equivalent to admitting your identity and joining the gang by default.

Is this a good thing or a bad thing for myself?

Lin Shu scratched his head subconsciously, analyzing his situation in his mind.

Yes, I came into contact with rituals, and the power provided by rituals can indeed change my life to a great extent.

But at the same time, I also faced serious life threats.

Whether it is the harm from Party A or the elusive "Heavenly Harvest", they are all urging me to speed up my pace.

And if you want to speed up...

The best way seems to be to use more powerful forces, right?

Is there any force in this world that is more powerful and has more resources than the official force?
